o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish یوقارو (yuqaru), from Proto-Common Turkic *yok-karï (“upper; upward”), from Proto-Turkic *yok.
Inherited from Proto-Common Turkic *kumïz, from Proto-Turkic *kumïŕ.
Equivalent to kərt + -ki. Compare Ottoman Turkish كركی (kerki), Turkmen kerki, Uyghur كەكە (keke).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish بیچاره (bī-çāre), from Classical Persian بیچاره. By surface analysis, bi- + çarə.
